title: Anatomy of a Genocide: Report of the Special Rapporteur on the Situation of Human Rights in the Palestinian Territories Occupied Since 1967
publisher_or_archive: United Nations General Assembly / Human Rights Council (A/HRC/55/73)
summary: Official UN Special Rapporteur report determining that there are reasonable grounds to believe the threshold indicating the commission of the crime of genocide has been met in Gaza, explicitly highlighting the role of automated AI targeting systems, mass surveillance, and multinational corporate providers in enabling systematic destruction.
